scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && go build -C packages/hook -o bin/ ./cmd/aang-hook
scripts.lint: go vet -C packages/hook ./... && node -e "const out=process.getBuiltinModule('node:child_process').execFileSync('gofmt',['-l','packages/hook'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(out){process.stdout.write(out);process.exitCode=1}" && pnpm lint:comments && pnpm lint:eslint
scripts.coverage: c8 vitest run --tags-filter=!benchmark && go tool covdata percent -i=coverage/hook
